description: Drive and inspect RazorConsole apps from the command line: run them in a pseudoterminal session, send input, wait for and assert on the screen, and read the component tree, focus, route, errors and logs of a Development or Debug app. Structured JSON results for CI and AI agents.

Test hosts for RazorConsole: mount components headlessly at a fixed terminal size, or run a whole console app in a real pseudoterminal (ConPTY on Windows, a POSIX PTY on Linux and macOS); send keyboard, mouse and raw terminal input, and inspect rendered frames. Works with any test framework.
Theme and token runtime for TKCode.Arc: design tokens, light and dark publishing, lazy control themes and package registration. Depends on Avalonia only.
Arc-style component library for Avalonia. Ports the free components of Arc (uiarc.dev) with their visual language and spring motion.

Geist and Geist Mono (SIL OFL 1.1, Vercel) for TKCode.Arc, registered as fonts:Geist and fonts:GeistMono; optional Silkscreen and VT323 pixel fonts (SIL OFL 1.1) as fonts:ArcPixel for the pixel theme.
The complete Lucide icon set (ISC) for TKCode.Arc: LucideIcon control and LucideGeometry markup extension. Its generator compiles only the icons an app uses.

Audio playback abstraction for TKCode.Arc (IAudioPlayer, AudioSource) with a silent simulated backend. Platform backends ship separately: TKCode.Arc.Audio.Native (desktop, miniaudio) and TKCode.Arc.Audio.Browser (WebAssembly).

Desktop audio backend for TKCode.Arc.Audio (Windows, macOS, Linux; x64 and arm64), built on miniaudio. Call ArcAudioNative.Use() at startup. The native library ships in the package under runtimes/<rid>/native.
WebAssembly audio backend for TKCode.Arc.Audio: one HTML audio element per player through JavaScript interop. Call await ArcAudioBrowser.UseAsync() at startup of a browser app.
Arc-style component library for Avalonia. Ports the free components of Arc (uiarc.dev) with their visual language and spring motion.

PDF viewing for TKCode.Arc: PdfViewer (PageViewer plus a sidebar with thumbnails and outline, search, text selection, links and the states of opening a document, password included) and Pdf.Source for a plain PageViewer, over a pluggable backend (IPdfBackend). Without a backend a real document repor…

Desktop PDF backend for TKCode.Arc.Pdf (Windows, macOS, Linux; x64 and arm64), built on PDFium. Call ArcPdfNative.Use() at startup. The native library ships in the package under runtimes/<rid>/native and its licenses under licenses/.

WebAssembly PDF backend for TKCode.Arc.Pdf, built on pdf.js. Call await ArcPdfBrowser.UseAsync() at startup of a browser app. pdf.js and its data files ship in the package as static web assets; their licenses are summarized in PDFJS-NOTICES.md.
Page-level block compositions for TKCode.Arc, built from Arc components. Ports Arc's free blocks and adds original ones.

Advanced charts for TKCode.Arc: Sunburst, SankeyFlow, FunnelChart, RadarChart, RealtimeStream, RaceBarChart, and DataGrid, a spreadsheet grid with range selection, inline editing, a fill handle, Excel and Sheets clipboard, undo, sorting, filtering, grouping, totals and export.

Special components for TKCode.Arc, the uiarc.dev "Special components" section: animated AI explainers (prompt cache, reasoning tree, speculative decoding, mixture of experts, agent loop) and pointer effects (dot grid, gravity well, ink fluid).

Terminal emulator for Avalonia: the TerminalView control and a managed facade over libghostty-vt (VT parsing, screen state, selection, input encoding). The native library ships in the package under runtimes/<rid>/native.
Workflow canvas for TKCode.Arc: show and edit graphs of steps and connections on a dotted canvas, watch a run step by step, pan and zoom, arrange automatically and undo.

IDE-style dock layout for TKCode.Arc: panes in tab groups, nested horizontal and vertical splits with resizable dividers, a document area, context-menu docking commands, keyboard navigation, and layouts saved to and restored from JSON.
Pixel-art theme (token overrides only, no controls) for TKCode.Arc: square corners, hard shadows, limited palette, light and dark.
Global corner style for TKCode.Arc (token overrides only, no controls): square corners or scaled corners for every Arc control, with colors, borders, shadows and motion unchanged.

Touch-first Arc components for Avalonia (first slice: page, navbar, tabbar, button, switch) with press states and 44px touch targets. Previewed in a desktop phone frame; not yet verified on Android or iOS devices.

dotnet new templates for TKCode.Arc: desktop and cross-platform (desktop + WebAssembly) apps with Arc's theme, fonts, Lucide icons, light/dark switching and saved preferences, in a blank, sidebar, header or dock layout, with optional MVVM, dependency injection, localization and tests (dotnet new tk…
Drawing for Sdcb.SimdCodecs: shapes, gradients, strokes and TrueType text over decoded pixels, with no native dependency. AOT-compatible.
WPF 两级（父/子）级联下拉选择框：左右分栏面板，点父类不关闭、点子类才选中关闭；零第三方主题依赖，支持外部样式注入。
